title: Azalea_Town
lead_summary:
Azalea Town exits West into Ilex Forest and East to Route 33.
The first time the player comes, the town is flooded and most buildings are not accessible or only partially. The Route 33 is also blocked by the water and construction workers.
This city contains Azalea Town's Gym, with Kurt as its leader, but cannot be challenged until the flood is resolved.
